name: otp-field
title: Otp Field
description: A one-time code typed into a row of boxes, one character each: the "enter the 6-digit code we emailed you" field. Built on Base UI's OTPField, which owns the hard parts: paste of the whole code into any box, the phone's "from Messages" autofill…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/otp-field

Installed to `components/ui/otp-field.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/otp-field';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/otp-field

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
